---
title: "Quarto + uv smoke test"
---

This small course project is a checkable starting point for authoring lessons.
Quarto owns the rendered page, while `uv` owns the reproducible Python
environment described by `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`.

The companion verification command checks that the project metadata and this
artifact are present and internally consistent:

```bash
uv run python verify.py
```

When the Quarto CLI is installed, render this project from the repository
root with:

```bash
quarto render course
```
